About Alma Vent

Logistics partner from Bulgaria for all of Europe

Alma Vent was founded in 2026 and is headquartered in Ruse, Bulgaria – a strategic hub at the crossroads of East and West. We specialise in the distribution of household, personal hygiene and food products, connecting manufacturers with markets across the European Union.

Our mission is simple: deliver on time, safely and with complete transparency – anywhere in Europe.

What We Distribute

Three categories, one solution

We manage the complete distribution chain for your products, from warehousing to final delivery.

Household & Professional Detergents

We distribute a complete range of household and industrial detergents – cleaning products, disinfectants, surface solutions and professional equipment.

Personal Hygiene Products

Shampoos, shower gels, soaps, creams and basic cosmetics – we distribute trusted brands to retail and HoReCa clients.

Food Products

Packaged foods, canned goods, staple products – in full compliance with all European standards for food transport and storage.

Our Network

Active routes across Europe

From Bulgaria, we reach 10 European countries. Ruse is the strategic centre of our operations.
